top_stories.ai_overview: Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model AI chip design firm Ricursive Intelligence has trained an open language model. ai_key_details: Other benchmark results show that Ripple does not match the also newly released Inkling 2 Small, but Ripple is likely easier to deploy on users' own hardware.

top_stories.ai_overview: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity Designing new medicines requires curating complex data from charts, figures and literature, training predictive models, and proposing candidate molecules to synthesize — a workflow that typically takes multiple days for a single iteration. top_stories.ai_what_happened: Using real-world lung cancer treatments, an agent searches through thousands of compounds, performs matched molecular pair analysis, and proposes novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in just an hour.
ai_key_details: Chemistry is one of science’s richest public records — spanning millions of structures across journal articles and vendor catalogs.
It provides a common representation that links physics and mathematics to the life and environmental sciences.
top_stories.ai_why_it_matters: The results of the analysis show that cyclization reduces the number of rotatable bonds while generally increasing potency, as expected.
top_stories.ai_technical_breakdown: Advanced cheminformatics systems must be able to unify these sources and deal with the many ways errors can arise in them.
